mapper.select: SELECT NOTE FROM ARENA_CONFIG WHERE ID = 1
mapper.update: MERGE INTO ARENA_CONFIG t USING (SELECT 1 AS ID, #{note} AS NOTE FROM dual) s ON (t.ID = s.ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.NOTE = s.NOTE, t.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ID, NOTE, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (1, s.NOTE, SYSDATE)
